incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert -> PROD tokenizer-service (us-west2) high-cpu + OOM events, severity: P1, incident id INC-20260315-7
Lynn: I'm on pager. Seeing a flood of alerts starting ~1771203400. CPU spikes on tokenizer pods then they go into CrashLoop with OOMKilled/evicted.
Jun: taking pager. Any impact to customer-facing endpoints?
Marta: yes — generation API /v1/generate is returning 502/504 and higher latency. A subset of requests were auto-failed over to smaller model variants, but a few customers saw timeouts.
Lynn: grabbing logs from one affected pod now
Lynn: ```
[2026-03-15T17:02:11Z] tokenizer.worker pid=2345 mem: 2.8G cpu: 98% processing prompt id=ab12...
E 17:02:13 RuntimeError: tokenizer exceeded memory threshold during bytepair decoding
Killed process 2345 (python) total-vm:3400000kB, anon-rss:2800000kB
Kernel: Memory cgroup out-of-memory: Kill process 2345 (python) score 925 or sacrifice child
``` 
Charles: I also see CUDA errors in another node log interleaved with OOM messages:
Charles: ```
[2026-03-15T17:03:02] cuda: out of memory. tried to allocate 512MB (GPU 0)
TensorRT: failed to allocate workspace -> falling back
Container restart reason: Error
``` 
Marta: looks like heavy pre-tokenization work is spilling into GPU path for some requests (we have hybrid CPU+GPU tokenizer path). High concurrency requests with long prompts causing tokenizer threads to spike.
Jun: kubectl snapshot from the cluster
Jun: ```
$ kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=tokenizer -o wide
tokenizer-5b7f6   0/1   CrashLoopBackOff   4   17m
tokenizer-6d8c9   1/1   Running            0   17m
tokenizer-8f0ab   0/1   Evicted            1   17m
$ kubectl describe pod tokenizer-5b7f6 -n prod
Events:
  Type     Reason     Age   From               Message
  ----     ------     ----  ----               -------
  Warning  OOMKilled  5m    kernel             Memory cgroup out of memory
  Normal   BackOff    3m    kubelet            Back-off restarting failed container
``` 
Lynn: initial mitigation steps I'm applying:
- Temporarily reduce tokenizer concurrency: set ENV TOKENIZER_MAX_THREADS=6 on deployment
- Apply CPU/memory request bump for tokenizer to avoid immediate eviction while we stabilize
- Add a pod anti-affinity to spread across nodes
Lynn: running command now
Lynn: ```bash
kubectl set env deploy/tokenizer TOKENIZER_MAX_THREADS=6 -n prod
kubectl patch deploy/tokenizer -n prod -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"tokenizer","resources":{"requests":{"cpu":"500m","memory":"1Gi"},"limits":{"cpu":"2","memory":"4Gi"}}}]}}}}'
kubectl rollout restart deploy/tokenizer -n prod
``` 
Marta: I pushed a temporary prompt-size limiter at the API gateway to reject >2000-token requests with 429, that should reduce pressure on the tokenizer hot-path.
Marta: `gateway config: prompt_max_tokens=2000` -> rolled out to edge nodes
Jun: started draining one node that had repeated evictions and cordoned it to avoid cascading node pressure
Jun: ```bash
kubectl cordon node/gpu-node-15
kubectl drain node/gpu-node-15 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
``` 
Charles: I see tokenization latency drop after the gateway limiter and env change. Error rate fell from 8% -> 2% over last 4m.
Eva: notifying support and affected customers with early impact assessment. ETA for stable: 20-25 minutes while we monitor restarts.
Lynn: logging mitigation timeline to INC-20260315-7 and creating a short runbook entry for immediate followups: increase tokenizer memory limit, add request circuit breaker, add tokenization CPU quota.
Jun: handoff in 10m — Marta will be primary oncall after 17:15 UTC. I'll keep monitoring until handoff complete.
Marta: taking handoff at 17:15 UTC. Current state: partial customer impact, throttles in place, node drain ongoing, rollout succeeded on 70% of tokenizer pods.
Marta: next steps ticklist:
- confirm no more OOMKilled events for 30m
- create postmortem ticket and link with prometheus graphs (/alerts/cpu, /alerts/memory, /slo/errors)
- prioritize a fix: ensure tokenizer pre-tokenization does not escalate to GPU path for CPU-only ops
Jun: adding immediate post-incident actions to backlog: limit tokenizer worker threads by default, add a safelist for long prompts requiring special handling, instrument per-request tokenization memory metrics.
incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-7 status -> mitigated (partial impact), duration: ~12m of elevated errors. Follow-up: postmortem required. Assigned: eng-runtime, eng-platform. SLA note: customers on Dedicated may need outreach.
Lynn: thanks team. Filing a short incident note and I'll take the postmortem draft. If any residual issues ping me directly.
Marta: confirmed. closing pager but keeping channel open for postmortem discussion. :white_check_mark:
